text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan has made a full recovery after her stay at the rest house, where she asks whether I'm really prepared to forge ahead with a racer who's as fragile as glass—liable to break at any moment.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To demonstrate my resolve as her trainer to ensure she's never pushed to breaking point, I show her the road map I've planned out for her future.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan accepts both my answer and my decision to stand by her as her trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After sharing our intentions with the Mejiro family's chief physician and gaining his permission to return to the academy, Mejiro Ardan and I get back on track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan delegates all decision-making regarding training and races during her junior year to me. And with that, our journey begins anew!
